title: The other side
description: A quiet front turns to reveal a little more, with details following the card's movement.
useCase: Present an optional second layer of information on a compact exploratory card.
interaction: Hover or tap the card; keyboard users can press Enter
reducedMotion: The two faces switch without rotation. Decorative pulses and stagger travel stop.
limitations: Keep essential information outside a hover-only reveal. This version also supports a native button's touch and keyboard activation.
look: Warm beige page with a single rounded cream card, a soft blurred amber glow at its centre, a dark bold title and bronze double arrow.
motion: Hover or tap flips the card in 3D over 500 ms ease-in-out; back lines slide and fade in 50 ms apart; front glow discs pulse in a 3 s loop.
adapt: The flip is `sf-flip-card` toggled by `data-flipped` (`rotateY` with a 500 ms transition and `backface-visibility`); back items use inline `transitionDelay`, front pulses use the `sf-flip-scale` keyframes. Replace the front title and the three feature strings; keep the button for touch and keyboard.
